verdict.rationale: Windmill lets users define scripts/flows triggered automatically by schedules (CRON), webhooks, emails, HTTP routes, websockets, Kafka, Postgres, NATS, SQS, MQTT, and other event sources, with retry/error handling and branching logic for rule-based automation. This directly matches the story of defining rules that trigger actions on events, with strong first-party documentation. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of complex event-rule chains and no community corroboration specifically confirming event-trigger reliability in production.
